ResearcherNotesProject: AI-draft (discovery sweep): Genuinely NEW project at the dead 'Trieste Monfalcone LNG Terminal' site (T100000130482, cancelled 2015 under Endesa/E.ON), staged separately per the dead-and-revived rule (different sponsor AND different design). Sponsor Smart Gas S.p.A. (vehicle of Alessandro Vescovini/Vescovini Group, with dock partner Molino Casillo S.p.A.) first proposed a conventional onshore small-scale LNG storage/regas/distribution terminal at Monfalcone in 2014; that filing was rejected by ministerial decree in 2017 (unrelated to, and after, the Endesa/E.ON record's 2015 cancellation) and was never itself entered in GEM. In September 2022 the same sponsor group pivoted to a wholly different design: an offshore floating LNG storage vessel ('gasiera'/mother ship, ~144,000-145,000 m3) moored ~20 nm off the Friuli-Venezia Giulia coast in the Gulf of Trieste, shuttled by barge to the Molino Casillo dock (Bacino di Panzano, Port of Monfalcone) where LNG is loaded into 40-ft ISO containers and distributed onward by truck/rail to industrial end-users in northern Italy, who regasify on their own premises (no onshore or offshore FSRU regasification at the terminal itself). This is a genuine ship-borne marine LNG import at Monfalcone (clears the scope gate) even though downstream distribution is virtual-pipeline-style. VIA screening request filed Sept 1 2022 (RINA Consulting engineering support); Region gave a second unfavorable opinion in 2023 and the Ministry's official VIA-registry procedure (va.mite.gov.it Oggetti/Info/8984) shows the screening concluded ('Stato: Conclusa') on 9 June 2023 with the outcome that the project must undergo a full VIA; a supply agreement for up to 400 ISO containers of LNG arriving by sea, plus formation of an SPV 'LNG Logistic' (Vescovini Group + Molino Casillo + an overseas LNG supplier), were reported in follow-up coverage (deliveries originally targeted for Jan 2023). Exhaustive search for a follow-on full-VIA filing or any 2024-2026 activity (MASE va.mite.gov.it registry search, Autorita di Sistema Portuale del Mare Adriatico Orientale materials, Friuli-Venezia Giulia regional acts, company/press coverage) found NOTHING after the June 2023 screening conclusion -- no full-VIA procedure has been opened, no approval, no rejection, no news. That is ~3 years of silence as of 2026-07, i.e. between the 2- and 4-year dormancy thresholds, so this is staged as `shelved`/`inferred 2 y` rather than `proposed`, with the June 2023 screening-conclusion sources (the strongest available regulatory record) cited as the dormancy evidence on BOTH Status [ref] and ShelvedYear [ref] per the inferred-shelved rule (no source uses the word 'shelved'; these establish the dormancy the inference rests on, anchored to the newest substantive milestone, not the earlier 2014/2017/2022 articles). Capacity: the only figure found for annual throughput (1 bcm/y, from adriaports.com) could not be reconciled with the concrete '400 ISO container' supply deal and carries no stated time basis (no 'annuo'/per-year qualifier on the source page) -- left unstaged; see wiki Background and qa entry.
Owner: Smart Gas S.p.A.; Molino Casillo S.p.A.
Location: Molino Casillo dock, Bacino di Panzano, Port of Monfalcone
AssociatedTerminals: Trieste Monfalcone LNG Terminal (T100000130482, cancelled -- dead site with new, unrelated sponsor/design proposal)
